The Samsung Galaxy S26 is a series of Android-based flagship smartphones developed by Samsung Electronics. It was announced on February 25, 2026 and released on March 11, 2026.[2]

Specifications

[edit]

All three models use a 120 Hz display. The S26 Ultra has a 6.9-inch display and a 200-megapixel main camera.
